svg.title: Risks
svg.desc: Placed by how likely it is and what it costs if ignored. Top right is what to fix first. Position carries the severity as well as the colour does, so a monochrome printout loses nothing.

so a monochrome printout loses nothing.
Stripe test key pasted into a
Worker size and CPU limits on
WHAT TO DO ABOUT EACH ONE
Unescaped staff text in the dashboards
Sweep js/admin.js, js/manager.js, js/sales.js, js/technician.js and the schedule modules through escapeHTML
Payment taken twice on a webhook redelivery
Key the write on the Stripe event id before the first real charge
Rate limit does not survive the instance
Cloudflare WAF rate limiting on /api/*, which the move makes free
Dashboards gated in the browser only
Prove with a customer account that /admin/ exposes nothing, then move the gate to a policy
The Cloudflare move retires both. One platform, one deploy path
Unverified NYC water figures published as fact
Check every number against NYC DEP reports, or mark it illustrative in the page
Schedule them, then restore one into a scratch project
Stripe test key pasted into a chat transcript
Roll it. It is a test key, and rolling it costs nothing
Stock 0 everywhere, so the shop reads sold out
Seed real stock with the stage options in phase 7
Worker size and CPU limits on the free plan
Let the deploy fail on size rather than guessing. Workers Paid is five dollars
The whole repository is published with the site
Publish from an explicit allow-list into dist/ rather than serving the repository root. Verified 2026-10-09: the migrations, the tests and the
task list are all downloadable from the live Vercel host
